name: transaction_velocity
description: Fraud read tool (tenant-scoped). Returns IP addresses with order-velocity bursts for the caller's tenant: IPs placing at least min_orders orders within the last window_hours, with per-IP order count, distinct customers, and value totals. Typed and enumerated — bounded parameters only, no caller-supplied SQL. tenant_id must equal the caller's identity claim.

tenant_id.description: Tenant to report on. Must equal the caller's verified tenant_id claim (enforced by Cedar before the tool runs).

window_hours.description: Look-back window in hours (default 24, capped at 168).

min_orders.description: Minimum orders from one IP within the window to be reported (default 3).
